NEWSANGUO_EVENT_NEW_THREE_KINGDOMS_WAY.p:
You have returned. It is the [b]New Three Kingdoms Way[/b] again—the starting point of every road, the gateway to every ending.

Back then, beneath the starry night, it was this path that led you to the [gold]Spire[/gold].

And now, it waits for you to set out once more. Where to?
Take the New Three Kingdoms Way
Return to this Act's [gold]Ancients[/gold] and add a [red]Heaven's Decay[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Through the portal, you once again gain the ability to travel anywhere.
By way of the New Three Kingdoms Way, you return to this Act's [gold]Ancients[/gold].
You arrive at [b]Chenliu[/b].
[gold][b]Yuan Shao[/b][/gold] sees you and says happily:
“[b][gold]Mengde[/gold][/b]! You're finally here! We've all been [sine][b]straining our eyes waiting[/b][/sine]!”
No sooner has he spoken than [b][gold]Gongsun Zan[/gold][/b] chimes in:

“If you hadn't come, [b][sine][rainbow]what would we eat[/rainbow][/sine][/b]?”
“Exactly!”

Then [gold][b]Yuan Shao[/b][/gold] hosts a banquet upon the command platform and lets the lords [sine][b]Triumph Brew[/b][/sine].
You prepare to:
Add a [red]Hungry[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold].
You drink some [gold][b]fine wine[/b][/gold]. It was brewed by [gold][b]Zhang Fei[/b][/gold] and boasts of being able to [sine][b]cure a hundred ailments[/b][/sine]. Utterly intoxicating.

You eat some [gold][b]meat from a half-year-old fawn[/b][/gold]. They say the cook used nine seasonings and a gentle flame to prepare it. Truly [sine][b]exquisitely delicious[/b][/sine]—you simply must try it.

You remind [b][gold]Han Fu[/gold][/b] that [b][gold]Yuan Shu[/gold][/b] still owes him [b]twenty thousand catties of grain[/b] and hasn't paid up. [b][gold]Han Fu[/gold][/b] is instantly displeased, and jabs a finger at Yuan Shu:

“With no [gold][b]grain[/b][/gold], am I supposed to send my [jitter]soldiers[/jitter] on a forced march [red]on empty stomachs[/red]?”

The lords start quarreling, and all of [b]Chenliu[/b] erupts.
“Why do you always speak up for him? Is he your [gold]lord and master[/gold]?”
“[b][gold]Han Fu[/gold][/b]! Why do you keep my [gold]three commanderies of Dangyang[/gold] and refuse to give them back?”
“[jitter]I'm done with this![/jitter]”
“[rainbow][sine]The sun rises in the west![/sine][/rainbow]”
...

The scene descends into chaos, and you seize the moment to make off with [gold][b]a few things[/b][/gold] and slip out of [b]Chenliu[/b].
NEWSANGUO_EVENT_WILD_NEUTRAL_AMBUSHERS.p:
You are crossing the wilds of the Nest when you hear a [red]rustling[/red] among the branches.

Suddenly [sine][b][gold]Wild Neutral Ambushers[/gold][/b][/sine] spawn ahead of you—you've been ambushed!
Turn and flee before they close in, avoiding this fight.
Begin a difficult fight, and reap plentiful rewards.
Before they can close in, you turn, slip into the undergrowth, and walk away without looking back.
NEWSANGUO_EVENT_THREE_VISITS_TO_THE_THAT: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage

Following the guidance of [red][b]Heaven[/b][/red], you set out for the thatched cottage where [gold][b]Zhuge Liang[/b][/gold] dwells.

But [gold][b]Guan Yu[/b][/gold] and [gold][b]Zhang Fei[/b][/gold] don't seem too happy about it.

“Brother, don't believe any of this. Everyone calls those scholars 'rotten Confucians'. And what is a rotten Confucian? Rotten stinky tofu! Whatever you do, don't go treating that stinky tofu like treasure!”
“Third Brother speaks to the heart—[rainbow][sine]A Grand Toast[/sine][/rainbow]!”
...
Arrive at the Cottage
Walk up to the cottage door and knock, asking to be received.

You arrive before the cottage and are met by a [gold][b]boy servant[/b][/gold].

“General of the Left of Han, Marquis of Yicheng, Governor of Yuzhou, Imperial Uncle Liu...”
“Your name is far too long, sir. I can't remember it. My master knew a distinguished guest would call soon, so he went off on a long journey.”

You are dumbstruck by the [gold][b]boy[/b][/gold]'s words. How insolent this [gold][b]Zhuge Liang[/b][/gold] is! You decide to:
We're Already Here, So Let's Rob the Cottage
Gain [gold]{FirstGold}[/gold] Gold.
Come Back in a Few Days
Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP to calm [gold][b]Guan Yu[/b][/gold] and [gold][b]Zhang Fei[/b][/gold] down.

After much effort, you finally calm [gold][b]Guan Yu[/b][/gold] and [gold][b]Zhang Fei[/b][/gold] down.

A few days later, you bring [gold][b]Guan Yu[/b][/gold] and [gold][b]Zhang Fei[/b][/gold] along and set out for the cottage once more. You enter and bow to the man reciting poetry inside:
“[gold][b]Liu Bei[/b][/gold] has long admired you, sir. At last I behold you in person!”
“General, you've come today hoping to see my elder brother [gold][b]Zhuge Liang[/b][/gold], haven't you?”
“Wait—then you are not [gold][b]Master Sleeping Dragon[/b][/gold]?”
...

Well then. This [gold][b]Zhuge Liang[/b][/gold] has gone off wandering again. You decide to:
We're Already Here, So Let's Rob the Cottage
Gain [gold]{SecondGold}[/gold] Gold.
Come Back in a Few Days
Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP to calm [gold][b]Guan Yu[/b][/gold] and [gold][b]Zhang Fei[/b][/gold] down.

You place absolute faith in [red][b]Lord Heaven[/b][/red]'s guidance and once again calm [gold][b]Guan Yu[/b][/gold] and [gold][b]Zhang Fei[/b][/gold]. After returning, you begin divining every day with a red-eared slider, continuing to commune with [red][b]Lord Heaven[/b][/red].

A few more days pass, and you decide to set out for the cottage again. Unlike the previous two trips, this time you hear the [gold][b]Song of Guan Yu[/b][/gold] on the way—surely this visit won't be in vain.

You enter the cottage and find [gold][b]Zhuge Liang[/b][/gold] asleep, his backside pointed at you. You decide to:
Set It on Fire!
Remove {RemoveCount} cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Wait Quietly
Transform {TransformCount} cards. Add a [red]Regret[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].

You give up trying to persuade them and let [gold][b]Guan Yu[/b][/gold] and [gold][b]Zhang Fei[/b][/gold] ransack the entire cottage.

Perhaps asking him to come out of seclusion wouldn't have been such a good thing after all.

You've had enough of [gold][b]Zhuge Liang[/b][/gold]'s insolence, and let [gold][b]Guan Yu[/b][/gold] and [gold][b]Zhang Fei[/b][/gold] ransack the entire cottage.

Perhaps, as [gold][b]Xu Shu[/b][/gold] said, rather than seek out a strategist, one should create one for oneself.
As for [gold][b]Sleeping Dragon[/b][/gold], let him go create a lord of his own.

You suddenly recall how the story unfolds from here, and you know what asking [gold][b]Sleeping Dragon[/b][/gold] to come out of seclusion will bring. So you hatch a scheme: have [gold][b]Guan Yu[/b][/gold] and [gold][b]Zhang Fei[/b][/gold] pretend to wait outside, while secretly ordering them to burn to death the man who made you walk this road three times.

After a while, the cottage is ablaze. The boy servant rushes to put out the fire, but you stop him:
“Do not disturb them!”

What you don't know is that [gold][b]Zhuge Liang[/b][/gold], like [gold][b]Zhou Yu[/b][/gold], possesses the [sine][b]invincibility of water and fire[/b][/sine] attribute—[red][b]fire damage[/b][/red] is [red][b]useless[/b][/red] against him. Watching [gold][b]Zhuge Liang[/b][/gold] emerge unscathed, you can only sigh at your failed plan:
“The man is truly a marvel!”

You wait before the cottage for a long while. At last, [gold][b]Zhuge Liang[/b][/gold] wakes.

As you take your leave, you hear the voice of [red][b]Lord Heaven[/b][/red]:

“From this moment on, [rainbow][sine]history has changed drastically[/sine][/rainbow]...”

But is asking [gold][b]Sleeping Dragon[/b][/gold] to come out of seclusion really a good thing? Perhaps one day, you will [red][b]regret[/b][/red] it...
